# Drinks Sommelier Skill for Muse

A personal beer-and-wine sommelier that builds a taste profile for you over time (taste rules plus liked/disliked lists): send a photo of a shelf or menu, or a plain list, and it researches each product on the web, scores it against your profile, and returns a #1 pick with a 0–100% preference score, alternatives, food pairings, and products to avoid. It is honest by design — it never invents and flags contradictions instead of smoothing them over. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: the skill is built to run web research on every product, so it works best when your Muse can search the web; you also need to set up your taste profile first. Beers and wines only — no spirits, no cocktails — and the examples lean European (Kwak, Leffe). Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
